signature_length_bytes.meaning: length of the owner's signature on the signed UserOperation

suffix_length_bytes.meaning: length of the trailing validUntil||validAfter suffix of the signature

suffix_authenticated_by_signer.meaning: whether the trailing validUntil||validAfter suffix is covered by the signer's authentication

relayer_holds_signed_userop.meaning: whether a relayer or observer holds a valid signed UserOperation

submitted_validity_longer_than_intended.meaning: whether the submitted UserOperation carries a validity period much longer than the owner intended

assumptions: The owner's signed UserOperation is valid and held by the relayer before submission.
The 77-byte signature format consists of a 65-byte signer portion plus a 12-byte validUntil||validAfter suffix.
The relayer submits the same UserOperation with the suffix stripped or rewritten without invalidating the signature.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete validUntil/validAfter values or numeric bounds for the intended time window, so the 'much longer validity period' is only a qualitative Boolean.
Report does not state whether the relayer needs any on-chain role or permission beyond holding the signed UserOperation.

limitations: The selected impact is potential; the plan formalizes only the report-supported conditional scenario in which the relayer rewrites the unsigned suffix to extend validity.
The 'much longer validity period' magnitude is not numerically defined in the report and is represented as a grounded Boolean.
Other listed impacts (earlier submission, post-expiry submission, reusable approvals) are not formalized by this plan.
